parameters.query: SELECT paper_id, topic, year, stance, methodology_score FROM papers;

INSERT INTO consensus_by_year
  (topic, year, weighted_support, weighted_contradiction, weighted_neutral, weighted_mixed, papers_count, average_methodology_score)
SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8
WHERE $9 = 'false'
ON CONFLICT (topic, year) DO UPDATE SET
  weighted_support = EXCLUDED.weighted_support,
  weighted_contradiction = EXCLUDED.weighted_contradiction,
  weighted_neutral = EXCLUDED.weighted_neutral,
  weighted_mixed = EXCLUDED.weighted_mixed,
  papers_count = EXCLUDED.papers_count,
  average_methodology_score = EXCLUDED.average_methodology_score;
